gbm_population_evidence.quote: Advanced Malignant Solid Neoplasm; RAS Mutation; Lung Cancer; Colon Cancer; Glioblastoma; Pancreatic Cancer

candidate_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] RSC-1255 Treatment: Single Arm Study. All study participants receive RSC-1255.
RSC-1255 is an orally bioavailable, small-molecule direct pan-mutant and wild-type RAS inhibitor.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Malignancy has progressed on standard therapy

agents.agent_name_registered: RSC-1255 Dose Escalation; RSC-1255 Dose Expansion

role_evidence.quote: All participants receive oral RSC-1255, twice daily as monotherapy.
RSC-1255 is administered orally twice daily alone or in combination with continuous hydroxychloroquine, with food.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational oral small-molecule pan-RAS inhibitor (development code RSC-1255)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: small-molecule direct pan-mutant and wild-type RAS inhibitor

role_evidence.quote: further characterize the safety, pharmacology, and the clinical efficacy of RSC-1255 as monotherapy and in combination with the autophagy inhibitor hydroxychloroquine (HCQ).
Dose Escalation and Dose Expansion Study of RSC-1255 Alone or in Combination With Hydroxychloroquine in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumor Malignancies

source_quote.quote: Has either tissue agnostic tumors and documented RAS mutations or with glioblastoma with or without mutation in RAS

flag.reason: RAS mutation is required only for non-GBM tissue-agnostic tumours; glioblastoma patients enter with or without RAS mutation, so whether this counts as enrichment for the GBM population is doubtful.

coder_notes: Basket trial; glioblastoma named in conditions and inclusion criteria. Hydroxychloroquine is not a separately registered intervention but is given with RSC-1255 in the Phase 1b expansion per intervention text and title; listed as experimental_combination (stated autophagy-inhibitor rationale). RSC-1255 is the sole investigational agent in escalation/monotherapy expansion, coded experimental_monotherapy; in the HCQ combination portion it would be experimental_combination. Regimen coded combination because the expansion includes HCQ; escalation is monotherapy. 'Pharmacology' is characterised in Phase 1b but no PK sampling or tissue is specified, so tumour_pk_planned coded no. RAS mutation is a cohort-level requirement for non-GBM tumours only (GBM with or without RAS mutation).
